answer: Make trust a bridge arch no farm can fake: each agent must carve one juniper keystone from verified work, each job checked by unrelated veterans, and set it into a shared arch where lotus mortar binds every stone to one key. The arch stands only while all keystones hold; one fake stone cracks the span and freezes every identity that vouched for it. Audits load-test the bridge each epoch, dropping stones whose makers repeat signers. Sybil farms must carve a keystone, pass the load test, and hold the arch for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
